## Scope and scientific interpretation

Only **`R6 Combined_real`** in `Corn_N_calculations.xlsx` is imported. Its existing `Group` values are used, not reconstructed: `V8` (early), `R1-R2` (mid), and `R5-R6` (late). The workbook contains 288 rows, but check your copy with the audit below.

**Target warning:** `R6_NNI_Combined` appears to be the sum of leaf, stalk, and ear NNI, *not conventional whole-plant NNI*. Furthermore, that column is populated on early-stage rows, apparently carrying a late-stage value across measurements of the same plot. Predicting it from early images would predict a future outcome, not contemporaneous early NNI. Therefore this notebook uses `R1 NNI` in `V8` and `R1-R2`, and `R6_NNI_Combined` only for `R5-R6`. The late target must be revalidated scientifically before claiming whole-plant NNI predictions. Group names are **developmental windows**, not necessarily identical measured targets. Do not pool performance metrics across groups as if their targets have the same definition.

**Pipeline:** PCA for unsupervised exploration → Elastic Net selects informative bands **within each training fold** → selected-band indices are computed → RF and radial SVM are tuned and tested by **held-out plot**. PCA is *not* used to select features from the response; it is a separate exploratory analysis.

## 5. Wavelength lookup and spectra

```{r wavelength-map}
# Read ENVI header wavelengths if available; otherwise approximate using
# the first and last wavelengths reported in the provided sensor screenshot.
read_hdr_wavelengths <- function(path) {
  s <- paste(readLines(path, warn = FALSE), collapse = " ")
  matched <- regmatches(s, regexpr("wavelength\\s*=\\s*\\{[^}]+\\}", s, ignore.case = TRUE))
  if (!length(matched) || !nzchar(matched)) stop("No wavelength array in HDR")
  vals <- sub("^[^{]*\\{", "", matched)
  vals <- sub("\\}.*$", "", vals)
  as.numeric(trimws(strsplit(vals, ",")[[1]]))
}

if (!is.na(hdr_file) && file.exists(hdr_file)) {
  wavelength_all <- read_hdr_wavelengths(hdr_file)
  stopifnot(length(wavelength_all) == 300)
  wavelength_source <- "ENVI header (exact)"
} else {
  wavelength_all <- seq(393.8, 1035.12, length.out = 300)
  wavelength_source <- "APPROXIMATE interpolation; supply HDR for publication"
  warning(wavelength_source)
}

band_map <- data.frame(Band = band_cols, Band_Number = 5:293,
                       Wavelength = wavelength_all[5:293])
head(band_map)
```

## 6. Exploratory PCA (within each group)

```{r pca-function}
run_pca <- function(dat, label) {
  x <- as.matrix(dat[, band_cols])
  ok <- rowSums(!is.finite(x)) == 0
  x <- x[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  d <- dat[ok, , drop = FALSE]
  nonconstant <- apply(x, 2, sd) > 0
  x <- x[, nonconstant, drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x) < 4 || ncol(x) < 2) return(NULL)
  p <- prcomp(x, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
  var <- p$sdev^2 / sum(p$sdev^2)
  scores <- bind_cols(d %>% select(Experiment, Plot_ID, Group, N_Treatment),
                      as.data.frame(p$x[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]))
  print(ggplot(scores, aes(PC1, PC2, color = N_Treatment)) +
          geom_point(size = 2.5) +
          labs(title = paste("PCA:", label),
               x = paste0("PC1 (", round(100*var[1], 1), "%)"),
               y = paste0("PC2 (", round(100*var[2], 1), "%)")) +
          theme_bw())
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r pca-run, fig.height=5}
for (g in unique(corn$Group)) {
  run_pca(filter(corn, Group == g), g)
}
```

## 7. Validation design and feature engineering

**Important:** spectral selection and vegetation-index choice are recalculated on each training fold. We evaluate *plots* held out, not spectra from plots also seen during training. Groups contain multiple experiments with different treatments; these results measure held-out-plot performance, **not** transferability to an unseen site or year.

```{r functions-splits}
# Assign all observations belonging to a plot to the same fold.
make_folds <- function(plot_ids, k, seed = 2026) {
  u <- unique(as.character(plot_ids))
  set.seed(seed)
  u <- sample(u)
  k <- min(k, length(u))
  if (k < 2) stop("Need at least two distinct plots")
  map <- setNames(rep(seq_len(k), length.out = length(u)), u)
  as.integer(map[as.character(plot_ids)])
}

safe_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  data.frame(n = length(obs),
             RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2)),
             MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred)),
             R2 = if (length(obs) > 2 && var(obs) > 0)
               1 - sum((obs - pred)^2) / sum((obs - mean(obs))^2) else NA_real_,
             Bias = mean(pred - obs))
}
```

```{r elastic-net}
# Screen bands using an internally CV-tuned Elastic Net on TRAINING plots only.
select_bands <- function(train, seed_local) {
  y <- train$NNI_target
  x <- as.matrix(train[, band_cols])
  keep <- apply(x, 2, sd) > 0
  x <- x[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(x) < 2) stop("Too few variable bands")
  foldid <- make_folds(train$Plot_ID, min(5, n_distinct(train$Plot_ID)), seed_local)
  fits <- lapply(alpha_grid, function(a) {
    cv.glmnet(x, y, alpha = a, foldid = foldid,
              family = "gaussian", standardize = TRUE)
  })
  errors <- vapply(fits, function(m) min(m$cvm), numeric(1))
  best <- fits[[which.min(errors)]]
  b <- as.matrix(coef(best, s = "lambda.1se"))
  nm <- rownames(b)[-1]
  sel <- nm[abs(b[-1, 1]) > 0]
  if (length(sel) == 0) {
    b <- as.matrix(coef(best, s = "lambda.min"))
    sel <- rownames(b)[-1][abs(b[-1, 1]) > 0]
  }
  # If Elastic Net selects many correlated bands, retain largest coefficients.
  coef_vals <- abs(b[sel, 1]); names(coef_vals) <- sel
  sel <- names(sort(coef_vals, decreasing = TRUE))[seq_len(min(length(sel), max_bands))]
  list(bands = sel, alpha = alpha_grid[which.min(errors)])
}
```

```{r vegetation-indices}
# Generate indices *only* from ENet-selected bands.
# Two-band NDI=(Ri-Rj)/(Ri+Rj); ratio=Ri/Rj.
# Region labels constrain biologically interpretable comparisons.
region <- function(w) {
  ifelse(w >= 520 & w < 600, "green",
  ifelse(w >= 620 & w < 680, "red",
  ifelse(w >= 680 & w < 750, "rededge",
  ifelse(w >= 750 & w <= 1000, "nir", "other"))))
}

candidate_pairs <- function(sel) {

  bands <- unique(sel)

  if (length(bands) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      a = character(),
      z = character()
    ))
  }

  pairs <- combn(
    bands,
    2
  )

  data.frame(
    a = pairs[1, ],
    z = pairs[2, ]
  )
}

# Model-derived candidate index screening is restricted to TRAINING data.
indices_for_data <- function(dat, pairs) {
  out <- data.frame(row = seq_len(nrow(dat)))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(pairs))) {
    a <- pairs$a[i]; z <- pairs$z[i]
    den <- dat[[a]] + dat[[z]]
    val <- ifelse(abs(den) > 1e-10, (dat[[a]] - dat[[z]]) / den, NA_real_)
    out[[paste0("NDI_", a, "_", z)]] <- val
  }
  out$row <- NULL
  out
}

pick_indices <- function(train, selection) {

  # Check bands selected by Elastic Net
  selected_regions <- band_map %>%
    filter(Band %in% selection$bands) %>%
    mutate(
      Region = region(Wavelength)
    ) %>%
    count(Region)

  print(selected_regions)

  # Generate candidate NDSIs
  pairs <- candidate_pairs(selection$bands)

  if (nrow(pairs) == 0) {
    return(pairs)
  }

  xi <- indices_for_data(train, pairs)

  scores <- vapply(xi, function(z) {

    ok <- is.finite(z) &
      is.finite(train$NNI_target)

    if (sum(ok) < 5 || sd(z[ok]) == 0) {
      return(0)
    }

    abs(cor(
      z[ok],
      train$NNI_target[ok]
    ))

  }, numeric(1))

  head(
    pairs[
      order(scores, decreasing = TRUE),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ],
    max_indices
  )
}
```

## 8. Random Forest and SVM, with held-out-plot CV

```{r models}
fit_predict <- function(train_x, train_y, test_x, model) {
  # Remove constant or nonfinite index columns based on training data.
  good <- vapply(train_x, function(v) all(is.finite(v)) && sd(v) > 0, logical(1))
  train_x <- train_x[, good, drop = FALSE]
  test_x <- test_x[, good, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(train_x) == 0 || any(!is.finite(as.matrix(test_x)))) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(test_x)))
  colnames(train_x) <- make.names(colnames(train_x), unique = TRUE)
  colnames(test_x) <- colnames(train_x)
  if (model == "RF") {
    fit <- ranger(y ~ ., data = data.frame(y = train_y, train_x),
                  num.trees = 500,
                  mtry = max(1, floor(sqrt(ncol(train_x)))),
                  min.node.size = 5, seed = seed)
    return(predict(fit, data = test_x)$predictions)
  }
  # Train-only centering and scaling for radial SVM.
  mu <- vapply(train_x, mean, numeric(1))
  sc <- vapply(train_x, sd, numeric(1))
  xs <- scale(as.matrix(train_x), center = mu, scale = sc)
  ts <- scale(as.matrix(test_x), center = mu, scale = sc)
  fit <- ksvm(x = xs, y = train_y, type = "eps-svr", kernel = "rbfdot",
              C = 1, kpar = "automatic", scaled = FALSE)
  as.numeric(predict(fit, ts))
}
```

```{r evaluation-function}
evaluate_group <- function(dat, group_name) {
  dat <- dat %>% filter(is.finite(NNI_target))
  valid_spec <- rowSums(!is.finite(as.matrix(dat[, band_cols]))) == 0
  dat <- dat[valid_spec, , drop = FALSE]
  if (n_distinct(dat$Plot_ID) < 8 || nrow(dat) < 12) {
    message("Skipped ", group_name, ": insufficient valid independent plots")
    return(NULL)
  }
  fold <- make_folds(dat$Plot_ID, n_folds, seed)
  outputs <- list(); selected <- list(); i <- 0
  for (f in sort(unique(fold))) {
    train <- dat[fold != f, , drop = FALSE]
    test <- dat[fold == f, , drop = FALSE]
    en <- select_bands(train, seed + f)
    pairs <- pick_indices(train, en)
    if (nrow(pairs) == 0) {
      message("Skipped ", group_name, " fold ", f,
              ": selected bands did not span required spectral regions")
      next
    }
    xtrain <- indices_for_data(train, pairs)
    xtest <- indices_for_data(test, pairs)
    selected[[length(selected) + 1]] <- data.frame(Group = group_name, Fold = f,
      Alpha = en$alpha, Band = en$bands)
    for (model in c("RF", "SVM")) {
      pred <- tryCatch(fit_predict(xtrain, train$NNI_target, xtest, model),
                       error = function(e) {message(conditionMessage(e)); rep(NA_real_, nrow(test))})
      i <- i + 1
      outputs[[i]] <- data.frame(Group = group_name, Fold = f, Model = model,
        Plot_ID = test$Plot_ID, Observed = test$NNI_target, Predicted = pred)
    }
  }
  if (!length(outputs)) return(NULL)
  list(predictions = bind_rows(outputs), selected_bands = bind_rows(selected))
}
```

```{r run-models}
# Change the switch in Section 2 to explicitly allow exploratory R5-R6 model.
groups_to_run <- c("V8", "R1-R2")
if (run_late_unvalidated) groups_to_run <- c(groups_to_run, "R5-R6")

results <- lapply(groups_to_run, function(g) {
  evaluate_group(filter(corn, Group == g), g)
})
results <- Filter(Negate(is.null), results)

if (length(results)) {
  predictions <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "predictions"))
  band_selection <- bind_rows(lapply(results, `[[`, "selected_bands"))
  write.csv(predictions, file.path(output_dir, "heldout_plot_predictions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(band_selection, file.path(output_dir, "elastic_net_bands_by_fold.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
} else {
  message("No eligible model runs. See audit and selected-band warnings.")
}
```

## 10. Research decisions before publication

1. Verify critical N dilution calculations. The `R6_NNI_Combined` column **must not** be reported as standard whole-plant NNI merely because its values are numeric.
2. `V8` and `R1-R2` currently use `R1 NNI`; check whether the R1 values are contemporaneous with **each** sampling date. If not, rename the objective as prediction of later R1 NNI from earlier reflectance, or provide contemporaneous early NNI values.
3. The selection code uses training-only screening, but RF/SVM hyperparameters above are baseline values. A final manuscript should implement nested plot-grouped tuning for RF (`mtry`, `min.node.size`) and SVM (`C`, `sigma`, `epsilon`).
4. Distinct study sites may have different nitrogen-management labels and canopy conditions. Validation on a separate year/site is a stronger generalization test than randomly held-out plots.
5. Supply exact ENVI wavelengths to make vegetation index definitions defensible. Band endpoints are only approximately calibrated without the header.

### 11.1 Settings for the raw-band comparison

```{r raw-settings}
raw_output <- file.path(output_dir, "raw_band_comparison")
dir.create(raw_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Final research run: test k = all bands, all bands - 1, ..., 1
raw_predictor_step <- 1L

# For quick debugging only, use 10; switch back to 1 for the actual analysis.
# raw_predictor_step <- 10L

# False = rerun. True = read each completed group's CSV if present.
reuse_raw_csv <- TRUE

# Same groups as the NDSI analysis above (R5-R6 disabled by default).
raw_groups <- groups_to_run
```

### 11.2 Training-only ordering of raw bands

```{r raw-ranking}
rank_raw_bands <- function(train) {
  y <- train$NNI_target
  x <- as.matrix(train[, band_cols, drop = FALSE])

  # Constant or invalid bands in this training fold are not usable.
  usable <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(x)), function(j) {
    all(is.finite(x[, j])) && sd(x[, j]) > 0
  }, logical(1))

  x <- x[, usable, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(x) < 1) return(character())

  # Use *training data only*. No test labels enter ranking.
  scores <- vapply(seq_len(ncol(x)), function(j) {
    val <- suppressWarnings(
      cor(x[, j], y, method = "spearman")
    )
    if (is.finite(val)) abs(val) else 0
  }, numeric(1))

  colnames(x)[order(scores, decreasing = TRUE)]
}
```

### 11.3 Run RF and SVM at every raw-band predictor count

```{r raw-evaluate-function}
evaluate_raw_path <- function(dat, group_name) {

  dat <- dat %>% filter(is.finite(NNI_target))
  good_rows <- rowSums(
    !is.finite(as.matrix(dat[, band_cols, drop = FALSE]))
  ) == 0
  dat <- dat[good_rows, , drop = FALSE]

  if (n_distinct(dat$Plot_ID) < 8 || nrow(dat) < 12) {
    message("Skipping raw-band comparison for ", group_name,
            ": insufficient independent plots")
    return(NULL)
  }

  fold <- make_folds(dat$Plot_ID, n_folds, seed)
  outputs <- list()
  counter <- 0L

  for (f in sort(unique(fold))) {
    train <- dat[fold != f, , drop = FALSE]
    test <- dat[fold == f, , drop = FALSE]

    ranked <- rank_raw_bands(train)
    p <- length(ranked)
    if (p < 1) next

    # Every possible predictor count from p down to 1 by default.
    k_values <- unique(c(seq(p, 1L, by = -raw_predictor_step), 1L))
    k_values <- sort(k_values, decreasing = TRUE)

    message("Group ", group_name, " | fold ", f,
            " | usable bands ", p, " | sizes ", length(k_values))

    for (k in k_values) {
      predictors <- ranked[seq_len(k)]
      train_x <- as.data.frame(train[, predictors, drop = FALSE])
      test_x <- as.data.frame(test[, predictors, drop = FALSE])

      for (method in c("RF", "SVM")) {
        estimate <- tryCatch(
          fit_predict(train_x, train$NNI_target, test_x, method),
          error = function(e) {
            message("Error in ", group_name, " fold ", f,
                    " k=", k, " ", method, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
            rep(NA_real_, nrow(test))
          }
        )

        counter <- counter + 1L
        outputs[[counter]] <- data.frame(
          Group = group_name,
          Fold = f,
          Model = method,
          Predictor_Set = "Raw bands",
          Predictors = k,
          Max_Predictors_Fold = p,
          Plot_ID = test$Plot_ID,
          Observed = test$NNI_target,
          Predicted = as.numeric(estimate)
        )
      }
    }
  }

  if (!length(outputs)) return(NULL)
  bind_rows(outputs)
}
```

### 11.4 Run all groups and save raw-band predictions

```{r raw-run, cache=FALSE}
raw_results <- list()

for (g in raw_groups) {
  path_g <- file.path(raw_output, paste0("raw_predictions_", g, ".csv"))

  if (reuse_raw_csv && file.exists(path_g)) {
    message("Reading saved raw-band path for ", g)
    raw_results[[g]] <- read.csv(path_g, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  } else {
    result_g <- evaluate_raw_path(filter(corn, Group == g), g)
    if (!is.null(result_g)) {
      write.csv(result_g, path_g, row.names = FALSE)
      raw_results[[g]] <- result_g
    }
  }
}

raw_predictions <- bind_rows(raw_results)
if (nrow(raw_predictions) > 0) {
  write.csv(raw_predictions,
            file.path(raw_output, "raw_predictions_all_groups.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r raw-performance}
  print(raw_performance %>%
          group_by(Group, Model) %>%
          arrange(desc(Predictors), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
          slice_head(n = 5), n = Inf)
}

# The NDSI metrics already created in Section 9 are the comparator.
ndsi_comparison <- data.frame()
if (exists("performance") && nrow(performance) > 0) {
  ndsi_comparison <- performance %>%
    mutate(Predictor_Set = "ENet-selected NDSIs",
           Predictors = NA_integer_) %>%
    select(Group, Model, Predictor_Set, Predictors, n, RMSE, MAE, R2, Bias)
}

if (nrow(raw_performance) > 0) {
  comparison_every_k <- bind_rows(
    raw_performance %>%
      select(Group, Model, Predictor_Set, Predictors, n, RMSE, MAE, R2, Bias),
    ndsi_comparison
  )

  write.csv(comparison_every_k,
            file.path(raw_output, "raw_vs_NDSI_comparison.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```

### 11.7 Find a simpler model, accounting for fold-to-fold error variation

This descriptive **one-standard-error** rule selects the **smallest k** whose mean fold RMSE is within one standard error of the minimum mean fold RMSE. It does not create a new independent held-out evaluation of that selected k. A repeat with nested tuning is needed before reporting the selected-k result as final predictive accuracy.

```{r raw-simplest}
raw_fold_metrics <- data.frame()
raw_simple <- data.frame()

if (nrow(raw_predictions) > 0) {
  raw_fold_metrics <- raw_predictions %>%
    filter(is.finite(Predicted)) %>%
    group_by(Group, Model, Predictors, Fold) %>%
    summarise(
      Fold_RMSE = sqrt(mean((Observed - Predicted)^2)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  raw_summaries <- raw_fold_metrics %>%
    group_by(Group, Model, Predictors) %>%
    summarise(
      Mean_RMSE = mean(Fold_RMSE),
      SE_RMSE = sd(Fold_RMSE) / sqrt(n()),
      Folds = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  raw_simple <- raw_summaries %>%
    group_by(Group, Model) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      best <- .x[which.min(.x$Mean_RMSE), , drop = FALSE]
      threshold <- best$Mean_RMSE + best$SE_RMSE
      eligible <- .x[.x$Mean_RMSE <= threshold, , drop = FALSE]
      simplest <- eligible[which.min(eligible$Predictors), , drop = FALSE]
      simplest$Best_k <- best$Predictors
      simplest$Best_mean_RMSE <- best$Mean_RMSE
      simplest$Threshold_1SE <- threshold
      simplest
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  write.csv(raw_simple,
            file.path(raw_output, "exploratory_simplest_models_1SE.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
  print(raw_simple, n = Inf)
}
```

### 11.8 Poster-focused comparison: full spectrum, simpler raw bands, NDSI

```{r raw-poster-table}
if (nrow(raw_performance) > 0) {
  full_raw <- raw_performance %>%
    group_by(Group, Model) %>%
    filter(Predictors == max(Predictors)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(Approach = "All raw bands")

  simplest_raw <- raw_simple %>%
    select(Group, Model, Predictors) %>%
    inner_join(raw_performance,
               by = c("Group", "Model", "Predictors")) %>%
    mutate(Approach = "Exploratory simplest raw")

  poster_comparison <- bind_rows(
    full_raw,
    simplest_raw,
    ndsi_comparison %>% mutate(Approach = "ENet-selected NDSIs")
  ) %>%
    select(Group, Model, Approach, Predictors, n, R2, RMSE, MAE, Bias)

  print(poster_comparison, n = Inf)
  write.csv(poster_comparison,
            file.path(raw_output, "poster_model_comparison.csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```
